title.zh: 简维柚 · 物理染色与狂热交棒
title.en: Jane / Velina / Yuzuha · Physical color and Passion handoff

summary.zh: 柚叶刷新后由简染物理，维琳娜按风华补气旋并回支；简按狂热与萨霍夫次数循环。
summary.en: After Yuzuha refreshes, Jane colors Physical. Velina restores Cyclone using Windbloom and assists back; Jane manages Passion and actual Salchow uses.

conditions.zh: 循环站位简→维琳娜→柚叶，可整体旋转；柚下切、维上切都接主攻。
conditions.en: Cyclic order Jane→Velina→Yuzuha, with equivalent rotations; Yuzuha assists next and Velina previous to the main attacker.

conditions.zh: 依据作者3.0明确队伍流程，角色机制以固定3.3正式源为准；乱流、紊乱及普通强击按实际触发分别判断。
conditions.en: Uses the author’s explicit 3.0 team flow with fixed release 3.3 mechanics; evaluate Vortex, Disorder and ordinary Assault as their actual distinct triggers.

conditions.zh: 教学适用于固定Gachabase正式3.3基础技能；默认0影无专武，不启用潜能觉醒。
conditions.en: Uses fixed Gachabase release 3.3 base skills; M0 without signatures by default, with no Potential awakening.

conditions.zh: 按实际资源、敌人异常、失衡与提示执行；没有固定秒数、帧数、连携次数或最高分承诺。
conditions.en: Follow actual resources, Anomaly, Stun and prompts; no fixed seconds, frames, Chain count or maximum-score claim.

label.zh: Asgater · 维简／爱柚维操作（3.0）
label.en: Asgater · Jane/Alice with Velina and Yuzuha (3.0)

label.zh: 小橙子 · 维琳娜风华与气旋（3.0）
label.en: Orange · Velina Windbloom and Cyclones (3.0)

label.zh: 小橙子 · 简的狂热与萨霍夫（1.1）
label.en: Orange · Jane Passion and Salchow (1.1)

label.zh: 简 · 固定 Gachabase 3.3
label.en: Jane · fixed Gachabase 3.3

label.zh: 维琳娜 · 固定 Gachabase 3.3
label.en: Velina · fixed Gachabase 3.3

label.zh: 柚叶 · 固定 Gachabase 3.3
label.en: Yuzuha · fixed Gachabase 3.3

label.zh: 简 · 专属音擎固定源
label.en: Jane · fixed signature source

label.zh: 维琳娜 · 专属音擎固定源
label.en: Velina · fixed signature source

label.zh: 柚叶 · 专属音擎固定源
label.en: Yuzuha · fixed signature source

label.zh: 开局
label.en: Opening

objective.zh: 先染物理，铺好气旋再接主攻。
objective.en: Color Physical, establish Cyclone, then return to the main attacker.

title.zh: 柚叶续增益，交给主攻染物理
title.en: Refresh Yuzuha buffs and let the main attacker color Physical

input.zh: 普通切柚叶，能量够时点按EX；命中后按实际主攻入场提示。
input.en: Switch normally to Yuzuha and tap an affordable EX; take the actual main-attacker entry prompt after the hit.

trigger.zh: 开局或增益／甜蜜惊吓需要刷新；不是每个循环都重放。
trigger.en: At opening or when buffs/Sweet Scare need refresh; do not recast every loop.

complete.zh: EX发动获得2糖点，重击挂甜蜜惊吓、命中给快支；重挂会清掉旧染色，让主攻下一次物理命中重新染色。
complete.en: EX activation grants two Sugar Points; its heavy hit applies Sweet Scare and its hit prompts Quick Assist. Reapplication clears old color, so the main attacker recolors with a Physical hit.

reason.zh: 固定站位使柚叶下一位和维琳娜上一位都是同一主攻。
reason.en: The cyclic order makes the same main attacker next after Yuzuha and previous before Velina.

fallback.zh: 能量不足且原增益仍在就普通回主攻继续；已就绪的柚叶Q也能续惊吓，但须重染，不能视为免费EX。
fallback.en: If energy is short and buffs remain, switch normally back to the main attacker. A ready Yuzuha Ultimate can refresh Sweet Scare but also needs recoloring; it is not a free EX.

signal.zh: 只响应主攻实际快支或连携，择一入场。
signal.en: Take the main attacker’s actual Quick Assist or Chain, exactly once.

title.zh: 按提示接主攻并确认物理命中
title.en: Enter on the actual prompt and confirm a Physical hit

input.zh: 按当前形态响应快支；若出现真实连携窗口则选择主攻连携。只执行一种入场。
input.en: Take the Quick Assist matching the current form; if an actual Chain window appears, choose the main attacker’s Chain. Execute one entry only.

trigger.zh: 提示确实指向主攻；简在狂热中使用对应狂热快支，不把两种形态连按。
trigger.en: The prompt really targets Jane; use the Passion-form Quick Assist when in Passion, never both forms in succession.

complete.zh: 自身物理命中建立／维持染色；只有连携发动才直接进入狂热并回满，快支不赠送这项回满。
complete.en: A Physical hit establishes/maintains color. Only Chain activation directly enters Passion and fills the meter; Quick Assist does not grant that refill.

reason.zh: 普通切人、不同快支形态和连携分开处理，强制连携不等于敌人失衡。
reason.en: Keep normal switches, Quick Assist forms and Chain distinct; a forced Chain does not mean the enemy is Stunned.

fallback.zh: 没有提示就普通切主攻，用合法物理攻击继续，并跳过此入场动作。
fallback.en: Without a prompt, switch normally to the main attacker, use a legal Physical attack and skip this entry move.

actionLabel.zh: 快速支援（当前形态）／连携：择一
actionLabel.en: Quick Assist (current form) / Chain: choose one

label.zh: 柚叶已染物理的糖衣效果按实际覆盖持续。
label.en: Yuzuha’s Physical-colored Sugarcoat persists for its actual coverage.

label.zh: 气旋仅在实际存续期间继续攻击；未凭空刷新。
label.en: Cyclone keeps attacking only for its actual remaining duration; no automatic refresh.

title.zh: 普攻命中积攒狂热，红光优先闪避
title.en: Build Passion through hits; dodge real red attacks

input.zh: 点按普攻持续命中；实际攻击到来时极限闪避，并在合法窗口接闪反。
input.en: Tap Basic for actual hits; Perfect Dodge incoming attacks and use a Dodge Counter in its legal window.

trigger.zh: 还未进入狂热，或需要正常补输出与资源；按敌人真实招式应对。
trigger.en: Before Passion or during normal damage/resource recovery; react to actual enemy attacks.

complete.zh: 心流满才进狂热；狂热伤害会消耗心流，极限闪避／招架可回复，不靠等候自动回满。
complete.en: Enter Passion only at a full meter. Passion damage spends it, while Perfect Dodge/Defensive Assist can restore it; waiting does not automatically fill it.

reason.zh: 给维琳娜登场前先留下主攻物理命中与实际狂热进度。
reason.en: Establish a main-attacker Physical hit and actual Passion progress before Velina enters.

fallback.zh: 已狂热就保留当前状态；若气旋需要补充，仍普通切维琳娜，只省略重复积攒。
fallback.en: If already in Passion, preserve it. If Cyclone needs refreshing, still switch normally to Velina and skip only redundant buildup.

signal.zh: 需要补气旋时普通切维琳娜。
signal.en: Switch normally to Velina when Cyclone needs replenishing.

title.zh: 缺风华才用扬清补，能量与风华分开看
title.en: Use Purifying Rise if Windbloom is short; track energy separately

input.zh: 普通切入维琳娜或完成合法招架后，有能量点按EX扬清；确需再补且能量够，可随后再按EX三重绝息。
input.en: After normal entry or a valid Defensive Assist, tap an affordable Purifying Rise. If more is needed and energy permits, follow it with Triple Deathblow.

trigger.zh: 准备释放风暴眼而风华不足90；现有风华够时可省略补充。
trigger.en: Eye of the Storm is needed but Windbloom is below 90; skip replenishing when it already suffices.

complete.zh: 扬清／三重绝息发动各加45风华，上限135；开战基础45。看当前风华，不用能量条冒充。
complete.en: Each Purifying Rise/Triple Deathblow activation gives 45 Windbloom, cap 135, with 45 at baseline battle entry. Read Windbloom, not the energy bar.

reason.zh: 原文口语中的“90能量”不当成风暴眼门槛；当前固定技能明确要求90风华。
reason.en: Do not treat the article’s shorthand “90 energy” as the gate: the fixed skill explicitly requires 90 Windbloom.

fallback.zh: 缺能量且风华不足就普通切主攻继续正常积蓄，下一步风暴眼与快支一起跳过；已有90风华也先普通切到维琳娜，仅跳过补EX，再接下一步。
fallback.en: If energy and Windbloom are both short, switch normally to the main attacker and skip the next Cyclone/assist segment. With 90 Windbloom already, still switch normally to Velina; skip only the refill EX and proceed.

title.zh: 风华够90再开风暴眼，回支主攻
title.en: At 90 Windbloom, summon the Cyclone and assist back

input.zh: 确认风华≥90，长按特殊技或普攻发动风暴眼，随后按主攻实际提示。
input.en: Confirm at least 90 Windbloom, hold Special or Basic for Eye of the Storm, then take the main attacker’s actual prompt.

trigger.zh: 维琳娜已在前场且风华满足；气旋已够用时别无脑重复覆盖。
trigger.en: Velina is active with sufficient Windbloom; avoid overwriting adequate Cyclone coverage unnecessarily.

complete.zh: 生成广域气旋并触发上一位主攻快支；首次命中浸染目标才确认赋彩，普通命中不等于已有风异常。
complete.en: Summon Sweeping Cyclone and trigger the previous main attacker’s Quick Assist. Chromatic Tint requires its first hit on a Contaminated enemy; an ordinary hit does not prove Wind Anomaly.

reason.zh: 交棒后气旋在实际持续时间内继续作用；0影赋彩不直接按2影的对应属性积蓄计算。
reason.en: The Cyclone continues for its actual duration after the handoff. At M0, do not count the corresponding-attribute buildup added by M2.

fallback.zh: 风华不够回上步恢复；已不需重放可普通切主攻并跳过提示动作。赋彩不符先检查目标实际浸染。
fallback.en: If Windbloom is insufficient, recover first. If recasting is unnecessary, switch normally and skip prompt entry. For wrong tint, inspect actual Contamination.

signal.zh: 维琳娜上一位主攻：真实快支／连携提示二选一。
signal.en: Previous main attacker before Velina: choose one actual Quick Assist or Chain prompt.

title.en: Enter on the actual prompt and confirm a Physical hit

actionLabel.en: Quick Assist (current form) / Chain: choose one

prep.zh: 辅助EX按当前能量；不假定开局全员满能量，能量不足先正常积蓄。
prep.en: Support EX uses current energy; do not assume everyone starts full. Recover normally if short.

label.zh: 常态循环
label.en: Regular loop

objective.zh: 维护气旋与主攻资源，用已确认节点交棒。
objective.en: Maintain Cyclone and main-attacker resources, using confirmed handoff cues.

title.zh: 有次数再跳萨霍夫，按心流择机回收
title.en: Use an available Salchow to recover Passion

input.zh: 狂热且有可用次数时长按普攻；可松开提前终结。连续攻击中若出现可招架黄光且有支援点，切维琳娜招架。
input.en: In Passion with an available use, hold Basic; release to finish early. During continuous hits, a real parryable flash and Assist Points allow a Defensive Assist to Velina.

trigger.zh: 实际处于狂热且有萨霍夫次数，心流需要回收；不把普通长按都当此招。
trigger.en: Passion is active with a Salchow use and room to restore the meter; an arbitrary held Basic is not this move.

complete.zh: 狂热中该招伤害可回心流；合法招架交棒后简仍完成终结一击。
complete.en: Damage from this move can restore Passion; after the valid Defensive Assist handoff, Jane still performs its finisher.

reason.zh: 把可用次数和心流分开；黄光续终结是作者正文确认的合轴节点。
reason.en: Track available uses separately from Passion. The author confirms the yellow-flash assist can overlap the finisher.

fallback.zh: 没有次数／非狂热就用普通输出恢复；若需维琳娜但无合法黄光，完成当前招后普通切维，并跳过招架卡。
fallback.en: Without a use/Passion, recover through normal attacks. If Velina is needed without a legal flash, finish the current move, switch normally and skip the parry card.

label.zh: 柚叶已染物理的糖衣效果按实际覆盖持续。
label.en: Yuzuha’s Physical-colored Sugarcoat persists for its actual coverage.

label.zh: 气旋仅在实际存续期间继续攻击；未凭空刷新。
label.en: Cyclone keeps attacking only for its actual remaining duration; no automatic refresh.

signal.zh: 真实黄光＋支援点才招架；否则普通切并跳过下一招架动作。
signal.en: Parry only a real flash with Assist Points; otherwise switch normally and skip the next parry move.

title.zh: 真正招架后才继续维琳娜准备
title.en: Use a real Defensive Assist before Velina setup

input.zh: 敌人攻击到来且有支援点时，按对应切换键招架；不是普通换人。
input.en: Use the corresponding switch at an incoming attack with Assist Points; this is not a normal switch.

trigger.zh: 上一位主攻在场，存在实际可招架攻击与支援点。
trigger.en: The main attacker is active, with a real parryable attack and Assist Points.

complete.zh: 确认招架成功；可按普攻接支援突击后再补风华。
complete.en: Confirm the successful parry; Basic may perform the valid Assist Follow-Up before Windbloom preparation.

reason.zh: 作者的黄光交接用于积累失衡；不保证每轮敌人固定给相同招式。
reason.en: The authored yellow-flash handoff builds Daze; enemy attacks are not guaranteed on a fixed schedule.

fallback.zh: 无黄光／支援点时普通切维并跳过此招；红光由当前角色闪避，不硬按招架。
fallback.en: Without a suitable flash/points, switch normally and skip this move. Dodge red attacks rather than forcing a parry.

label.zh: 仅上一事件确实在萨霍夫连续攻击中合法招架时，简继续终结一击。
label.en: Only if the previous event legally parried during Salchow’s continuous attacks, Jane continues its finisher.

title.zh: 缺风华才用扬清补，能量与风华分开看
title.en: Use Purifying Rise if Windbloom is short; track energy separately

input.zh: 普通切入维琳娜或完成合法招架后，有能量点按EX扬清；确需再补且能量够，可随后再按EX三重绝息。

title.zh: 狂热期用可负担的EX积蓄物理
title.en: Use an affordable EX during Passion for Physical buildup

input.zh: 处于狂热且能量足够时点按EX，确认目标仍在攻击范围。
input.en: In Passion with enough energy, tap EX and keep the target in range.

trigger.zh: 实际能量足够；优先在狂热与辅助覆盖内使用。
trigger.en: Enough actual energy; prefer Passion and active support coverage.

complete.zh: 踢击与横扫实际命中后按当前物理积蓄结算，不承诺一次EX必强击。
complete.en: Resolve actual kick/sweep hits and Physical buildup; one EX does not guarantee Assault.

reason.zh: 作者建议狂热期用EX，气旋在其真实存续内同时输出。
reason.en: The author recommends EX during Passion; Cyclone contributes only during its actual duration.

fallback.zh: 能量不足用普攻／合法闪反；未狂热先按资源恢复，不空等EX。
fallback.en: Without energy, use Basic/legal Dodge Counters. Rebuild Passion when needed instead of waiting idly for EX.

prep.en: Return to the first two opening events only when Yuzuha coverage/Sweet Scare needs refresh, then recolor Physical.

prep.zh: 没有补气旋需求就留主攻，不强制每轮完整换人；气旋不足但无合法黄光时普通切维并跳过招架。
prep.en: Stay on the main attacker if Cyclone needs no refresh; if it does and no legal flash exists, switch normally to Velina and skip the parry.

prep.zh: 红光由简真实极限闪避回心流；没有攻击不能凭空获得闪避收益。
prep.en: Real red attacks allow Jane to Perfect Dodge and restore Passion; without an attack, no dodge reward is granted.

label.zh: 爆发窗口
label.en: Burst window

objective.zh: 提前完成辅助准备，按现有资源输出。
objective.en: Prepare support before the window, then spend actual available resources.

title.zh: 缺风华才用扬清补，能量与风华分开看
title.en: Use Purifying Rise if Windbloom is short; track energy separately

input.zh: 普通切入维琳娜或完成合法招架后，有能量点按EX扬清；确需再补且能量够，可随后再按EX三重绝息。
input.en: After normal entry or a valid Defensive Assist, tap an affordable Purifying Rise. If more is needed and energy permits, follow it with Triple Deathblow.

trigger.zh: 准备释放风暴眼而风华不足90；现有风华够时可省略补充。
trigger.en: Eye of the Storm is needed but Windbloom is below 90; skip replenishing when it already suffices.

complete.zh: 扬清／三重绝息发动各加45风华，上限135；开战基础45。看当前风华，不用能量条冒充。
complete.en: Each Purifying Rise/Triple Deathblow activation gives 45 Windbloom, cap 135, with 45 at baseline battle entry. Read Windbloom, not the energy bar.

reason.zh: 原文口语中的“90能量”不当成风暴眼门槛；当前固定技能明确要求90风华。
reason.en: Do not treat the article’s shorthand “90 energy” as the gate: the fixed skill explicitly requires 90 Windbloom.

fallback.zh: 缺能量且风华不足就普通切主攻继续正常积蓄，下一步风暴眼与快支一起跳过；已有90风华也先普通切到维琳娜，仅跳过补EX，再接下一步。
fallback.en: If energy and Windbloom are both short, switch normally to the main attacker and skip the next Cyclone/assist segment. With 90 Windbloom already, still switch normally to Velina; skip only the refill EX and proceed.

title.zh: 风华够90再开风暴眼，回支主攻
title.en: At 90 Windbloom, summon the Cyclone and assist back

input.zh: 确认风华≥90，长按特殊技或普攻发动风暴眼，随后按主攻实际提示。
input.en: Confirm at least 90 Windbloom, hold Special or Basic for Eye of the Storm, then take the main attacker’s actual prompt.

trigger.zh: 维琳娜已在前场且风华满足；气旋已够用时别无脑重复覆盖。
trigger.en: Velina is active with sufficient Windbloom; avoid overwriting adequate Cyclone coverage unnecessarily.

complete.zh: 生成广域气旋并触发上一位主攻快支；首次命中浸染目标才确认赋彩，普通命中不等于已有风异常。
complete.en: Summon Sweeping Cyclone and trigger the previous main attacker’s Quick Assist. Chromatic Tint requires its first hit on a Contaminated enemy; an ordinary hit does not prove Wind Anomaly.

reason.zh: 交棒后气旋在实际持续时间内继续作用；0影赋彩不直接按2影的对应属性积蓄计算。
reason.en: The Cyclone continues for its actual duration after the handoff. At M0, do not count the corresponding-attribute buildup added by M2.

fallback.zh: 风华不够回上步恢复；已不需重放可普通切主攻并跳过提示动作。赋彩不符先检查目标实际浸染。
fallback.en: If Windbloom is insufficient, recover first. If recasting is unnecessary, switch normally and skip prompt entry. For wrong tint, inspect actual Contamination.

signal.zh: 维琳娜上一位主攻：真实快支／连携提示二选一。
signal.en: Previous main attacker before Velina: choose one actual Quick Assist or Chain prompt.

title.zh: 按提示接主攻并确认物理命中
title.en: Enter on the actual prompt and confirm a Physical hit

input.zh: 按当前形态响应快支；若出现真实连携窗口则选择主攻连携。只执行一种入场。
input.en: Take the Quick Assist matching the current form; if an actual Chain window appears, choose the main attacker’s Chain. Execute one entry only.

trigger.zh: 提示确实指向主攻；简在狂热中使用对应狂热快支，不把两种形态连按。
trigger.en: The prompt really targets Jane; use the Passion-form Quick Assist when in Passion, never both forms in succession.

complete.zh: 自身物理命中建立／维持染色；只有连携发动才直接进入狂热并回满，快支不赠送这项回满。
complete.en: A Physical hit establishes/maintains color. Only Chain activation directly enters Passion and fills the meter; Quick Assist does not grant that refill.

reason.zh: 普通切人、不同快支形态和连携分开处理，强制连携不等于敌人失衡。
reason.en: Keep normal switches, Quick Assist forms and Chain distinct; a forced Chain does not mean the enemy is Stunned.

fallback.zh: 没有提示就普通切主攻，用合法物理攻击继续，并跳过此入场动作。
fallback.en: Without a prompt, switch normally to the main attacker, use a legal Physical attack and skip this entry move.

actionLabel.zh: 快速支援（当前形态）／连携：择一
actionLabel.en: Quick Assist (current form) / Chain: choose one

trigger.en: Enough actual energy; prefer Passion and active support coverage.

input.zh: 本人喧响已到极且窗口仍有效时按Q。
input.en: Press Ultimate only when Jane’s own Decibels are ready and the window remains useful.

trigger.zh: Q实际就绪；已有满心流时可先消耗再决定，不为等待回满错过窗口。
trigger.en: Ultimate is actually ready; with a full meter, spend first if useful without waiting through the window.

complete.zh: 发动时直接进狂热并回满心流，随后确认攻击命中；回满不是命中后才生效。
complete.en: Activation immediately enters Passion and fills the meter; then confirm the attack hits. The refill does not wait for a hit.

reason.zh: 将资源重启与伤害命中分开，之后萨霍夫仍检查实际可用次数。
reason.en: Separate resource reset from damage hits; still check Salchow’s actual available uses afterwards.

fallback.zh: Q未就绪就省略，按已有心流／次数继续；不假定全队共享喧响。
fallback.en: Skip an unready Ultimate and continue with existing meter/uses; never assume shared squad Decibels.

title.zh: 有次数再跳萨霍夫，按心流择机回收
title.en: Use an available Salchow to recover Passion

input.zh: 狂热且有可用次数时长按普攻；可松开提前终结。
input.en: In Passion with an available use, hold Basic; release to finish early.

trigger.zh: 实际处于狂热且有萨霍夫次数，心流需要回收；不把普通长按都当此招。
trigger.en: Passion is active with a Salchow use and room to restore the meter; an arbitrary held Basic is not this move.

complete.zh: 狂热中该招伤害可回心流；留场则确认终结一击后继续。
complete.en: Damage from this move can restore Passion; when staying on-field, finish before continuing.

reason.zh: 保留实际心流循环，不为了固定顺序提前浪费回收。
reason.en: Maintain the actual meter rather than wasting recovery for a rigid sequence.

fallback.zh: 没有次数或未狂热就回普通输出；心流足够时可保留次数，等实际需要再用。
fallback.en: Without a use or Passion, return to normal attacks. Save the use when the meter already suffices.

label.zh: 柚叶已染物理的糖衣效果按实际覆盖持续。
label.en: Yuzuha’s Physical-colored Sugarcoat persists for its actual coverage.

label.zh: 气旋仅在实际存续期间继续攻击；未凭空刷新。

prep.zh: 柚叶增益、物理染色与气旋尽量在失衡前准备好；已覆盖就省略维琳娜准备和对应快支，留主攻。
prep.en: Prepare Yuzuha buffs, Physical color and Cyclone before Stun when possible; if already covered, skip Velina setup and its assist, staying on the main attacker.

prep.zh: 简按心流缺口安排本人Q；心流与萨霍夫次数足够时不为固定轴强行回满。
prep.en: Place Jane’s own Ultimate around the actual meter gap; do not force a reset when meter/Salchow uses already suffice.

prep.zh: 连携只按实际提示，不把柚2强制连携当真实失衡；不保证相同Boss或金数下固定次数。
prep.en: Use only actual Chain prompts. Yuzuha M2 forced Chain is not real Stun; no fixed count is promised across bosses or investment levels.

text.zh: 柚1开战加能量不等于每轮免费EX；仍看能量是否够用。
text.en: Yuzuha M1 starting energy is not a free EX every loop; check actual affordability.

text.zh: 柚2重击命中非失衡敌人可按20秒间隔强制连携；快支与连携按真实提示择一，强制连携不是失衡。
text.en: Yuzuha M2 can force a Chain on a heavy hit against a non-Stunned enemy with a 20s cooldown. Choose the actual assist/Chain prompt; forced Chain is not Stun.

text.zh: 维1提高气旋失衡与对应抗性穿透，可能提前进失衡；资源准备未满时不硬套同一秒轴。
text.en: Velina M1 improves Cyclone Daze and specified RES ignoring; Stun may arrive earlier, so do not assume an unchanged timed resource schedule.

text.zh: 维2风化也能回风蚀（5秒间隔），赋彩气旋才增加对应属性积蓄；该额外积蓄不参与异常伤害结算。
text.en: Velina M2 also grants Windbite from Windswept with a 5s cooldown, and tinted Cyclones gain matching-attribute buildup excluded from Anomaly DMG calculations.

text.zh: 维6消耗2风蚀后返1受6秒间隔限制；别把每次乱流都当气旋或返还。
text.en: Velina M6 refunding one after spending two Windbite has a 6s cooldown; not every Vortex summons a Cyclone or refunds.

text.zh: 维专武需两次EX招式造成风伤才叠到2层、给全队精通；同一招多次命中最多记1层。
text.en: Velina’s signature needs Wind damage from two EX uses to reach two stacks and grant team AP; repeated hits within one move count once.

text.zh: 柚专武的全队精通要追加攻击实际命中；有装备不等于增益已生效。
text.en: Yuzuha’s signature team AP needs an actual Aftershock hit; equipping it alone does not activate the buff.

text.zh: 简1增加萨霍夫可用次数上限，并非每次进入狂热自动赠两次；以实际剩余次数为准。
text.en: Jane M1 increases the Salchow use cap; it does not say every Passion entry grants two uses. Read the actual remaining uses.

text.zh: 简2强化命中啮咬目标与该目标强击的收益；仍须先实际命中挂啮咬，不把任意气旋命中等同简已命中。
text.en: Jane M2 improves attacks/Assault against a Gnawed enemy; first apply Gnawed through Jane’s actual hit, not an arbitrary Cyclone hit.

text.zh: 简4由全队真实强击／紊乱触发异常增伤；单独乱流不自动当作紊乱触发。
text.en: Jane M4 activates its Anomaly buff on actual squad Assault/Disorder; Vortex alone is not automatically Disorder.

text.zh: 简6全队施加强击即可直接进狂热并回满，回收节奏会改变；仍检查萨霍夫实际次数，不能虚构无限次数。
text.en: Jane M6 enters/refills Passion when the squad inflicts Assault, changing recovery timing. Still check actual Salchow uses rather than inventing unlimited uses.

text.zh: 简专武进入接战或极限闪避直接满3猎意；冲刺攻击逐层刷新有间隔，不必每次起手硬做三次冲刺。
text.en: Jane’s signature gives all three Predatory Instinct stacks on combat entry or Perfect Dodge. Dash Attacks stack with a cooldown; three forced opening dashes are unnecessary.

baseOnlyReason.zh: 这套简维柚教学核对的是未觉醒技能；简觉醒会改变普攻、萨霍夫与EX，并增加狂热强袭。选择潜能后使用对应阶数的基础动作方案，专用合轴待另行核对。
baseOnlyReason.en: This Jane/Velina/Yuzuha lesson audits the unawakened kit. Jane’s awakening changes Basic, Salchow and EX, adding Passion Onslaught. With Potential selected, use the rank-matched foundational actions until the specialist overlap is separately reviewed.
